name: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay
overview: A public technical institute in Powai. Its official contact page lists the institute board line and separate examination office contacts.

fees.summary: Fees depend on program, admission year, and student category. Check the institute for the applicable current schedule.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad
overview: A public technical institute in Telangana. The institute publishes semester-wise fee schedules and separate schedules for foreign-national students.

fees.summary: Semester fees vary by course, cohort, and student category. See the institute's current semester-wise schedule before applying.

name: Manipal Academy of Higher Education
overview: A private deemed university in Manipal. Its 2026 admissions fee page links separate general-category, foreign/NRI, and hostel fee schedules.

fees.summary: 2026-27 fees vary by program and student category. The official page provides separate general, foreign/NRI, and hostel schedules.

name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology
address: 77 Massachusetts Avenue, Cambridge, MA 02139, United States
overview: A private research university in Cambridge, Massachusetts. MIT publishes a yearly undergraduate cost-of-attendance budget and need-based financial aid information.

fees.summary: 2026-27 undergraduate tuition: US$66,720/year. MIT's estimated total cost of attendance is US$92,760/year before financial aid, including housing, food, and other costs.

name: University of Oxford
overview: A public research university in Oxford. Undergraduate course fees vary by fee status and course; overseas tuition is published separately from living costs.

fees.summary: For 2027 entry, overseas undergraduate course fees range from £39,620 to £66,580/year; clinical medicine may be higher. Living costs are additional.

name: University of Cambridge
address: The Old Schools, Trinity Lane, Cambridge CB2 1TN, United Kingdom
overview: A public research university in Cambridge. International tuition varies by course, with an additional annual College fee and living costs.

fees.summary: For 2027 entry, Computer Science and Engineering tuition is £46,872/year for international students. College fees and living costs are additional; other course tuition differs.

fees.summary: Fees depend on program and admission category. Check the official admissions pages for current fees.

name: National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli
address: Tanjore Main Road, Tiruchirappalli 620015, Tamil Nadu, India

fees.summary: B.Tech, 2026 admission (Open/Open-EWS/OBC-NCL/ICCR/DASA-CIWG): ₹62,500 tuition per semester; listed first-semester total ₹1,25,550 including one-time charges. Other categories and semester totals differ.

fees.summary: International integrated programs: M.Tech tuition US$5,500/year plus US$100 caution deposit; M.Sc tuition US$3,450/year plus US$50 deposit. This is not the domestic B.Tech fee.
